primary.label: Franchise primary
primary.description: Aidan's serious Franchise save. Primary team TBD — set later with `config --game madden27 --primary-team <NFL team>`. Until then prep/play run the unassigned meta scheme pack.

lab.label: Franchise lab
lab.description: Optional practice/lab save (mirrors CFB ohio_state). Freer experiments; strong postgame results promote to the primary profile.

online_baseline.note: Scheme-first inventory, not a locked team identity. 6 D + 2 O = 8/8 Active for USER games (Aidan cap). CPU games = offense-only (O macros only).

scheme_pack.label: Unassigned primary scheme pack
scheme_pack.offense_source: Buccaneers formations (Gun Doubles Clamp Stack, Gun Trips X Nasty, Gun 5WR Tight, Pistol Trips) — Bucs ranked #1 by Madden Prodigy (2026-08-11); later rankings lead with Shotgun Classic / Texans, but Clamp Stack is the consensus meta formation either way
scheme_pack.defense_source: 49ers / Titans Saleh 4-3 (consensus #1 D): Nickel Over home, Single/Double Mug disguise, Dime 3-2 Odd on passing downs; zone-match book — rush four, drop seven
scheme_pack.note: Meta scheme, NOT Aidan's Franchise team. When a primary team is set, prep retargets deltas; personas and call language stay the same.

doctrine_priors.offense: Clamp Stack home (Texas Y-Stutter Wheel / Mtn Shuffle Verts Smash / Return Bench); zone runs (Inside Zone, Same Side Zone, HB Stretch) vs two-high; 5WR Tight Mesh Post / Clear Deep / Mtn concepts on money downs. Avoid Aggressive blocking (Sep 3 TU holding).
doctrine_priors.defense_default: Nickel Over home (Cover 4 Quarters / Cover 3 Match / Tampa 2). Rush four, drop seven — zone-match, not a blitz book. Single Mug disguise; sims/stunts (Nickel Sim 2, Field Sim 3) over contain (Sep 3 TU: OTs pick up contain). One user job. Macros situational.
doctrine_priors.prediction_rule: One tell = log + mild bump. Targeted macro only on REPEATED tendency (2+) this game in similar D&D.

Pistol Deuce Close.why: Civil.GG top-10: HB Dive (Pistol Deuce Close) — general-purpose run.

Gun Tight.why: Civil.GG top-10: Tight Crosses (Texans Gun Tight) beats man, match and zone.

Gun Off Trips Close.why: Civil.GG top-10: Y Option Wheel beats man and zone (Chargers concept).

split_field_zone.offense: Two-high/split-field user: zone runs first (Inside Zone / Same Side Zone / HB Stretch), Hi Lo Cross + Mesh Post underneath; don't force Mtn Shuffle Verts Smash into safeties.
split_field_zone.defense: Explosive shot + scramble persona: Cover 4 Quarters home; MATCH-4 after repeated verticals; SPY after repeated scrambles.

pressure_heavy.offense: Pressure persona: O-PROT ready, man/blitz beaters (Texas Y-Stutter Wheel, Mtn Stick Wheel, Mtn Triple Slants); Gun Tight Tight Crosses changeup.
pressure_heavy.defense: Crossers + bubbles + scramble persona: Cover 3 Match / Tampa 2; MESH-RAT / SPY on repeats.

c2_c3_mixer.offense: C2/C3 mixer: Mtn Double Post vs C2, Mtn Shuffle Verts Smash / Clear Deep vs C3; possession in RZ.
c2_c3_mixer.defense: Compressed + GL persona: STACK vs Clamp/bunch repeats; don't sell out run at GL.

two_high_money_downs.offense: CPU two-high on money downs: take free underneath (Mesh Post, Hi Lo Cross, Stick) and zone runs; no forced shots into sticks coverage.

unknown.offense: Thin persona: meta baseline as-is — zone runs, Clamp Stack easy completions.
unknown.defense: Thin persona: Nickel Over home, no macros until repeated tells this game.
